highlights: Features for a super-app that bundles more than 40 microapps as packages.
Maintenance and versioning (tags) of the shared dependencies used by every microapp.
Native real-time feature flags (~1 s) instead of the up to 24 h of Firebase Remote Config.
AI-powered What's New generator that analyzes each microapp's changes and writes the release notes.
App releases to the App Store and Google Play.
Architecture reviews in the internal SDK (for example, the Strategy pattern for feature flag connections).
Mobile app development for international clients.
In-house products end to end: idea, design, development and release.
